scope: Field Collector local encrypted-vault reset control

implementation.local_store: The locked-vault screen offers a browser-confirmed deletion of the Field Collector IndexedDB database and known legacy localStorage keys.
implementation.cross_tab_behavior: Other open Field Collector tabs close their IndexedDB connections and lock their in-memory app state when storage changes. The deleting tab reports if another tab blocks deletion.
implementation.server_boundary: Local deletion does not revoke server-side device enrollment or erase already-synced server records.

additional: node --test tests/test_mobile_offline_shell.mjs passed both offline-shell checks.
The Python pytest wrapper was unavailable because pytest is not installed; its underlying Node test command passed directly.

rollback: Revert the Field Collector source, test, and documentation changes, then rebuild only the candidate app service. No database rollback is needed.
